The NDLEA commander in the state, Offor Kenneth Onyesoh, disclosed this while speaking on a radio programme monitored in Port Harcourt, the state capital.
Onyesoh urged parents and members of the public to warn their children against involvement in drug-related activities, saying dealers were exploiting minors because they believed they would escape prosecution if arrested.
